title: TOR - CMG Capacity Building and BDS Support Program - Revised and Final April 2026
description: PMO-RALG invites qualified firms to provide Business Development Services (BDS) for training, capacity building and mentoring of Community Microfinance Groups (CMGs) under the World Bank-financed PAMOJA Project. Busokelo District Council is among the targeted implementation areas.
